title: Pathway finder
subtitle: Answer a few simple questions; we check the routes to work and live abroad and tell you which fit best.
error: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

empty.title: Coming soon
empty.body: The routes are being prepared. Soon you can find yours here.

goal.title: Why do you want to go?
goal.help: From your answer, we only check the routes that suit you.
goal.work_hint: Find work with the experience and skills you have, and stay
goal.study_hint: Study, then stay after you graduate
goal.any_hint: Tell me the best way to stay

question: Question {{number}}

age.title: How old are you?
age.help: Age earns points in most work routes.
age.label: Age (years)

education.title: What is your highest degree?
education.help: If you are studying, pick the degree you will get.

english.title: How is your English?
english.help: IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo. Without a certificate, your own guess is enough.
english.scale: Which exam is your score in?

work_years.title: How many years of work in your field?
work_years.label: Years of work

field_occupation.title: What did you study, and what is your job?
field_occupation.help: From your field and job we check whether it is on each country's in-demand lists.
field_occupation.help_field: Search for the field of your latest degree.
field_occupation.field_hint: Type your field or specialisation, e.g. software, civil or nursing.
field_occupation.field_not_found: No field by that name. Try a shorter word, or English.
field_occupation.occupation_help: These are common jobs for your field. Not there? Type its name.
field_occupation.search_hint: In Persian, English or the job code
field_occupation.search_help: Jobs come from the international list of occupations (ISCO), so their names are general. Can't find yours? Search more broadly, e.g. «nurse» rather than «operating-room nurse».
field_occupation.not_found: No job by that name. Try a broader word or English, or pick «I don't know / none» and our adviser will check.

recognition.title: Is your degree assessed or recognised in another country?
recognition.help: In Germany, for example, your university is listed in anabin. Not sure? Our adviser will check.
recognition.which: In which country, and how fully?

job_offer.title: Do you have a formal job offer from an employer abroad?
job_offer.help: Only a formal, written job offer.

shortage_occupation.title: Is your occupation on a country's in-demand list?
shortage_occupation.help: Not sure? Answer no and our adviser will check.

listed_occupation.title: Is your occupation on a country's skilled occupation list?
listed_occupation.help: Not sure? Answer no and our adviser will check.

skilled_occupation.title: Does your job count as skilled?
skilled_occupation.help: Jobs that need a degree or a trade are usually skilled. Not sure? Answer no.

skills_assessment.title: Have you passed a country's skills assessment?
skills_assessment.help: Some work routes need one, such as Australia's.

stay_months.title: Have you lived, worked or studied outside Iran?
stay_months.help: Some routes give points for time in the same country.
stay_months.which: Which countries, and for how many years?

partner.title: What about your partner?
partner.help: In some routes a partner earns points too.

budget.title: How much can you spend on the first year?
budget.help: Tuition and a year of living, in tomans. We compare it with each country's costs.

remote_work.title: Do you work remotely now?
remote_work.help: Employed or freelance, for a company or clients outside the country you want to go to, who let you work from there.

income.title: What is your monthly income?
income.help: Net. We convert it to euros at today's rate and compare it with the minimum the visa asks.
income.no_rate: Today's rate isn't available; we use the latest one.

remote_months.title: How long have you worked with this company or client?
remote_months.help: Since your work together started. Some visas ask a few months at least.

employer_years.title: How long has that company been in business?
employer_years.help: The company you work for. Freelance? Count your main client.

children.title: How many children are coming with you?
children.help: Some visas ask more income for each person coming along. None? Leave it at zero.
children.label: Children

gpa.title: What is the GPA of your latest degree?
gpa.help: Out of 20. We compare it with Scorize applicants with a GPA close to yours.

nomination.title: Has a state or region of Australia nominated you, or will it?
nomination.help: Subclass 190 needs a state's nomination, and 491 a regional area's (or a relative living there). None? Pick "No" to see where you can go without one.

options.regional: Yes, a regional area or a relative there (for 491)

first.title: Your first route
first.more: A few more questions check more countries

results.none: With these answers, no route you qualify for now
results.disclaimer: This is an estimate and each country's rules can change. An adviser makes the final check.
results.intro: These fit where you are today. We recommend the first one.

consult.title: Take the next step with our adviser
consult.body: An adviser sees your answers and calls you with the exact route.
consult.done: Request sent, we will call you soon

manage.title: Migration pathways
manage.subtitle: A route shows to customers after "Checked, publish".
manage.empty_body: Make the first one with "New route".

edit.saved: Saved. Customers don't see it until it is checked.
edit.published: Published. Customers see this route from now on.
edit.verify_failed: Add and save its requirements or points first.
edit.name: Official name
edit.requirements_help: Each box is a must: the customer needs every box ("and"). Inside a box, any one option is enough ("or").
edit.label: Text the customer sees
edit.maximum_help: This number itself doesn't count. Empty: no limit.
edit.condition_error: This condition isn't valid: fix the minimum, maximum or value.
edit.points_help: For points tests: each row gives the points of the best band the customer is in.
edit.summary: What it is (one or two plain sentences)
edit.notes_help: What the rules leave out: money to show, quotas, invitations.
edit.asks_help: Worked out from the requirements and points.
edit.try_person: 28, bachelor's, IELTS 6.5, 4 years of work, no German
edit.before_body: Compare the requirements and points with the official page, then press "Checked, publish". Any later change hides the route from customers until it is checked again.
edit.study: 5. A year of study and after
edit.study_help: Give all the costs or none. The admission-chance quiz shows them on the country's card.
edit.after_study: The way to stay from there
edit.one_is_enough: Any one of these is enough
edit.family_help: If the minimum rises with the family (Spain's digital nomad visa, say): what is added for people coming along. Empty: the same for everyone.
edit.per_first: Added for the first person coming (partner, or a child)
edit.ranking_help: If the country invites by a ranking score once the pass mark is met, customers see their estimated score.
edit.cutoff_help: After each draw, enter its lowest invited score. Customers see it beside their own. The route stays published.

intro.title: Find your way abroad.
intro.body: Answer a few short questions. We check every route to work and live abroad for you and tell you which ones fit.

keys_hint: Press an option's number on your keyboard
number_hint: Use + and − or drag the bar to change the number

rail.title: Checking for you
rail.note: With each answer we check every country's work and residence routes ourselves. You don't need to pick a route.

improve.title: What would help you
improve.work_years: Once you have {{value}} years of work
improve.passes: {{text}}, you get {{points}} more points and pass

study.no_rate: In tomans: no exchange rate yet

near.title: Close to the minimum
near.body: Your income is just above the minimum ({{list}}). A change in the exchange rate could take it under; an adviser will check it closely.

shortage_occupation.yes: Your job is on {{country}}'s shortage list
shortage_occupation.no: Your job is not on {{country}}'s shortage list

listed_occupation.yes: Your job is on {{country}}'s skilled occupation list
listed_occupation.no: Your job is not on {{country}}'s skilled occupation list

skilled_occupation.yes: Your job counts as skilled in {{country}}
skilled_occupation.no: Your job doesn't count as skilled in {{country}}

exit.title: Leave the pathway finder?
exit.body: Your answers stay on this device, and next time you carry on from this question.

admission.title: Chance of admission
admission.based: Based on {{n}} Scorize applicants with a final result in this country and degree.

ranking.title: Express Entry ranking score (estimate)
ranking.cutoff: Lowest score invited in the latest draw ({{date}}): {{cutoff}}.
ranking.cutoff_undated: Lowest score invited in the latest draw: {{cutoff}}.
ranking.note: Canada invites the people with the highest scores. A partner's points, Canadian work or study and French aren't counted here, so your real score may be higher.

whatif.title: What if…
whatif.body: Change one thing and see what it opens. Your real answers stay as they are.
whatif.nothing: With this change, nothing changes for your routes.
